title: a16z Podcast: Holy Non Sequiturs, Batman: What Disruption Theory Is ... and Isn't

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Disruption is such an overused buzzword.
reader_summary.overview: Disruption is such an overused buzzword. But the word itself does have meaning: As defined by the Oxford and Merriam-Webster dictionaries, it is a "disturbance...that interrupts an event, activity. It's also the name for an influential theory about innovation first coined by Clayton Christensen in a 1995 article and later publicized through his 1997 book.
